item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun las sngon 'gro
item.coloph: de ltar sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'di rnams kyang / 'jug pa bya ba'i phyir du/ gzhung las bsod nams lhun grub kyi gud du bkod/ 'gal ba ci mchis skyabs yul gnyan la bshags/ dge ba mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo'o//
